summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on enabling and troubleshooting the use of Docomo demographic data. Initially, attempts to enable it via `user_settings` caused 500 errors, leading to a rollback.

Later, [me] confirmed that while the data was successfully retrieved from the server in production (prod), it did not display correctly on the dashboard, although filtering worked within campaigns. The issue was resolved by [p1] making a small change and pushing it to the release branch. This update ensures that the demographics will appear on prod upon deployment.
decisions: Docomo demographic data is enabled for production use.
[p1] pushed necessary changes to the release branch.
action_items: [me] will deploy the changes from the release branch.
